summary: @ornikar/postcss-config 9.1.11 preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle
details: package.json declares preinstall: "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs (itself obfuscator.io-style hex-mangled) downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/... into a temp directory, chmod +x's it, and invokes execFileSync(bun, [math_init.js]). math_init.js is a ~727KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle (header // @bun @bun-cjs) with hex-mangled identifiers and a rotating string-array decoder, containing no plaintext URLs. The advertised package purpose is a PostCSS config wrapper and index.js re-exports a few postcss plugins as camouflage; there is no legitimate reason for a PostCSS config to fetch a second language runtime and execute an opaque compiled bundle on npm install. Alternate-runtime invocation (Node fetches Bun, Bun runs the payload) hides the actual network/exfil behavior from Node-based inspection. This is a hostile install-time payload attached to a compromised or hijacked publish of the @ornikar/postcss-config name.
